productDirection.reason: The resumable personal course workflow is now reachable through authenticated, exact typed jobs and a strict Web client while the default response remains a small human-facing projection with no source, card, outline, deck, manifest, or evidence identifiers.

decisions: Dispatch personal create, status, and resolution jobs in the authenticated main Helper process so background scheduling is never delegated to an orphan worker process.
Keep create and resolution to persistence plus scheduling and keep status read-only, each behind a five-second server ceiling.
Return exactly runId plus the seven-field public view; build a friendly ready-course projection with numbered chapter, lesson, and source aliases instead of opaque storage identities.
Start recovery of persisted nonterminal runs at product startup and join the personal supervisor on every server exit path.
Use matching strict Pydantic and Zod contracts and parse every Helper result before the Web client returns it.
Correct the API health regression expectation to schema version 8, the contiguous migration already established in Task 3.
residualRisk: The typed workflow is not yet the default visible product flow; Task 7 must replace the four-step authoring entry with the concise light personal experience and keep governed internals behind progressive disclosure.
nextAction: Task 7: implement the personal-first light UI using the existing design tokens and components.
